mythology: Sati's fingers (Anguli) fell here; having dropped, the sacred relic dissolved into the ether, giving the deity the title 'Alopi' (the one who disappeared into grace).
festivals: Kumbh Mela / Maha Kumbh / Magh Mela
pilgrimage_significance: Located in Tirtharaj Prayag; completing the holy Triveni bath is accompanied by seeking blessings at this premier finger-peetha of Adi Shakti.
historical_notes: Celebrated in Matsya Purana and Padma Purana as the spiritual womb of Tirtharaj Prayag where Lord Brahma conducted the primal sacrifice (Prakrishta Yajna).
